verdict.rationale: Maritime documents provisioning a dedicated agent micro-VM for each of your end users through its SDK, which is a fleet-style capability. The only limits stated are plan agent counts, such as 3 agents on the free plan and 'a set number of agents' per subscription. No concurrency limits, scale figures or throughput numbers are documented. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-execution limits, evidence of large-scale concurrent fleet operation, rate limits or quotas beyond plan agent counts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run large concurrent fleets of sandboxes with documented concurrency limits

citations.quote: Give every one of your users their own agent with the TypeScript or Python SDK.
provision is idempotent on it: it returns the existing agent if there is one, else creates a new one. Safe to call on every sign-in.
the free plan includes 3 agents, no card required
One subscription, a set number of agents, flat prices for extras.
